name: ACTRIMS Forum 2027
organizer: Americas Committee for Treatment and Research in Multiple Sclerosis
description: ACTRIMS Forum is the annual scientific and clinical meeting of the Americas Committee for Treatment and Research in Multiple Sclerosis. The 2027 Forum, themed Charting the Path Forward, is held in Phoenix, Arizona with an online option for virtual attendees.
